title: Shadow in the Fractured Void
description: A dark, muscular humanoid creature with glowing purple accents crouches in the center of a chaotic, shattered crystalline environment. Purple energy tendrils and bright blue electrical arcs emanate from its body and the surrounding fractured structures.
prompt: A muscular dark humanoid entity crouching in the center of a chaotic abstract space filled with sharp fractured crystalline shards and debris. Long flowing purple energy tendrils and bright blue electrical arcs emanate from its body and connect to the broken structures around it. Dark fantasy atmosphere with high contrast, dramatic lighting, textured brushwork, moody and menacing tone.
